questions.question:
What does this print?
a = [1, 2, 3]
b = [1, 2, 3]
if a == b:
    print("equal")
else:
    print("different")

What does this print?
a = [1, 2, 3]
b = [1, 2, 3]
if a is b:
    print("same object")
else:
    print("different objects")
questions.answer: different objects (== checks value, is checks identity)
